messages:
leah (sales): FYI Marigold AI wants a short POC to validate latency for their search reranker + generation flow. Request: dedicated pool + VPC peering, want estimate & provisioning timeline. Target window mid-May. cc @tess @omar

omar (solutions): quick baseline q: model mix and typical token lengths? also concurrency/QPS targets please

leah (sales): Models: GenX-70B (main) + GenX-13B reranker. Prompts ~800 tokens, some evals 1536. Expected steady QPS 4-8, stress to 20 for short windows. Concurrency target ~36 sessions.

tess (infra): For GenX-70B at those seqs, H100-80GB recommended. Proposed pool: reserved baseline 4 x h100 + 2 x a100 (for rerankers & batch), optional spot +2 GPUs for bursts. Autoscale: min=4, target=6, max=8. Region preference: us-east4; fallback us-central1. Provision ETA ~72-96h after quota ok.

leah (sales): They explicitly asked if we can do a Private deployment (control plane in their VPC) or if peering is sufficient. Also they want scoped API keys limited to this pool and short rotation. Pricing: two-week POC estimate pls.

ana (security): mTLS + scoped keys ok. If Private deployment, need extra compliance review + HSM/KMS plan. For peering: we'll need customer CIDR, admin list, and SIEM syslog endpoint. Also require DPA signed before we ship keys.

tess (infra): Network snippet for peering (example): ```peer cidr: 10.42.0.0/22
allowed egress: 443 to control-plane.redwood: 35.210.0.0/16
allow inbound from 10.42.0.0/22 to pool-ips: tcp 22,443
auth: mTLS```

omar (solutions): Asking about burst strategy: do we want spot for the extra +2 GPUs? If so, add note that spot preemption may affect long-running evals; we can route batch jobs to spot and critical inference to reserved H100s.

tess (infra): Yes spot for burst is fine. Suggest policy: reserved handles online inference (min 4), batch/eval routed to spot/A100. If preemption occurs, batch retries to reserved if capacity allows. We'll include routing policy in ticket.

leah (sales): Can you also give a rough cost ballpark for the two-week run so ops can budget? They asked to compare reserved baseline vs fully metered.

tess (infra): Ballpark numbers (region-dependent): reserved 4 H100 + 2 A100 commit ~= $55k/mo. For two-week POC (min 4 active, average burst to 6 for 25% time) ~= $30k-$36k. Fully metered for similar usage could be ~ $40k for two weeks. I'll attach detailed calc in the provisioning ticket.

ana (security): Also flag: if Marigold needs SOC2 docs or custom DPA terms, that'll add review time. Tell customer to surface legal contact now.

ops-bot: Provision request PR-4920 opened by tess: marigold-poc-hybrid-h100-a100. Region=us-east4, fallback=us-central1. Pool config and autoscale policy attached. ETA provisioning window 72-96 hours pending quotas. Link: https://internal.redwood/provision/PR-4920

leah (sales): thanks. I'll collect CIDR and billing contact and get DPA started. Blocking items: DPA signed, CIDR, billing contact, and quota approval on us-east4.

omar (solutions): I'll draft a short perf plan (50p/95p/99p latency checks + throughput ramps) to run once pool is live.

tess (infra): once ops ticket has quota numbers I'll schedule the provisioning slot. Will add firewall example and cost breakdown to PR-4920.

leah (sales): great, scheduling kickoff after ticket updates. Marking thread blocked-on: PR-4920 (tess), DPA signed (legal).
